notes.title: Blagmoz 1.1 | Level Editor Update
notes.notes:
Dearest Mozzlings,

The moon has shined its glorious light upon us on this magical day, because the Blagmoz Level Editor Update is finally out! Don't let the name fool you, there's a whole lot more than a level editor that comes with it, too. With this update, we hope to make Blagmoz a more complete package that allows you to express your creativity and customize your experience.

Level Editor
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44694444/077809b74ffe3a640233752fcdbe73528bb8c9b8.gif
Create, share, and play community Blagmoz levels with the brand new Level Editor through Steam Workshop! We're super excited to see what you all create. If you want a preview of what's possible, check out this fantastic level pack made by one of our team members, Castle Outskirts.

New Game Mode and Modifiers

We've added a new game mode, Spell Rush, where where wizards compete to get kills with increasingly difficult spells. 
And, you can now create potion loadouts to start each round with a set of potions. You can play a game where everyone has wing and a bubble shield, or play an entire frog v. frog v. frog v. frog match!

New Potions
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44694444/b5829874d8c38867204709c4c643588d6d150a5b.gif
This update brings two new potions; Midas's Blessing (above) which allows you to turn to gold and block attacks at a moment's notice, and Lightning in a Bottle, which brings the lightning powerup from The Ashes into the rest of the realms in the game.
The Shield spell's shove attack has also been buffed significantly, and it now stuns players who are hit by it and tracks environmental kills as kills for the player who pushed you into them.
Giant Gnome
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44694444/3cd77c349f9f61e0f0d6f10159d04490d426ab83.gif
The Forest now has a new game mechanic -- the Giant Gnome! Offer him a corpse and be rewarded (or cursed) with a random potion effect. 

One last thing, join our Discord to show off your levels, bounce ideas around, or chat with us and other players. We look forward to seeing you there :)

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44694444/77a4fa3cc9fe9442c1ee5f6eeaa35fec2453c08f.gif

Special thanks to our Discord members who helped test out the update!

This update has been a long time in the making, and we're really pleased with how it turned out. Have fun, and happy casting!

Full Update Notes

Level Editor and Steam Workshop integration
Added Spell Rush alternative game mode, where wizards compete to get kills with increasingly difficult spells
Added a Potion Loadouts system where you can set up potion loadouts to start each level with
Four new unlockable characters
Added 2 new potions, Midas's Blessing and Lightning in a Bottle
Tutorial has been reworked, and checkpoints have been added.
Tons of balance tweaks and other improvements!
Shield “shove” attack has a new trajectory, and counts environmental kills as kills for the player wielding the shield for a short time after players are shoved
Added a hints system to help new players get the hang of the game, which can be disabled in the settings.
Added a notification above players' heads when they try to pick something up while their hands are full
Orbs are brighter and easier to see
Level up messages (“Apprentice of Magic…”) now clearly state that you gain extra dashes
Walking over a pickup (potion, key, chest, etc.) will now highlight the one you will pick up
Player portraits / potion effects now turn translucent when a player is standing behind them
Various visual polishing additions
Floor booster runes speed threshold has been lowered, so you don’t need to wavedash anymore to get the speed boost, just run full speed and slide
Sacrificed Tomes of Teleportation are now destroyed by the ooze (prevents an issue where players could continuously revive inside the ooze)
Frogs can now double jump, and more potions work with the frog transformation

Bug fixes

Fixed a weird bug where you couldn’t stomp other wizards as a master or legendary wizard if you had Curse of Limits
Controls menu is more clearly labeled
Fixed a visual bug with character unlock banner
Fixed Swords not spawning in random spell spawners
Sacrificed Tomes of Teleportation should now work correctly consistently in online play
Fixed a rare softlock bug in online play
Other miscellaneous bug fixes

notes.title: New Levels + Improvements | Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Greetings Mozzlings!

This update brings improvements to the netcode, fixes bugs, and adds some brand new levels, as well as updates to old ones.

New Content:

5 brand new levels!


Bug Fixes + Improvements:

Improved syncing of thrown physics objects in online multiplayer and reduced rubber banding (particularly noticeable with Tomahawks)
Fixed a bug with the Sword which caused it to swing when out of ammo on client screens
Many small balance tweaks to existing levels
Tome of Teleportation is now unlocked with The Ashes
Locked realms now have text above them when they are about to be unlocked and are unlocked after 2 games each instead of 3
Added sparking lightning hint on Altars that will create lightning strikes in The Ashes
Crumbling platforms now have a unique look in each realm
Fixed a bug that caused the joystick to not work in the menus sometimes
Bottomless pits have been deepened


Happy casting!

notes.title: Bug Fixes | Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hi Mozzlings,

Today's update is a small one, and just includes some bug fixes and minor gameplay improvements.

New Features:

The Invite Friends button now uses the Steam overlay's invite friends feature


Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug where a cleansing potion would not remove all negative effects under certain circumstances
Fixed a bug in the player movement which made it difficult to walljump immediately after dashing into a wall


Happy casting!

notes.title: Wisps! | Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello Mozzlings,

This update adds some helpful wisps that bring you into the level, making it much easier to tell where you have spawned and how long the spawning period is.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug with pausing in a local game
Wall and boost runes now sync properly
Minor decorative fixes on some levels
Addressed a balance issue on a level in The Ashes
Adjusted Sword hitbox to better match the animation
Shield now blocks Tomahawks more predictably


Happy casting, everyone!

notes.title: QOL: Controls Customization | Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Greetings Mozzlings,

This update brings the long-awaited quality of life feature of controls customization to Blagmoz! You can now change your control bindings to whatever you'd like, separately for each player. Head to the Settings menu to check it out.

New features:

Customizable controls for keyboard and gamepads
Using a DualShock or PlayStation controller now shows the appropriate glyphs

Bug fixes:

Fixed a bug which sometimes caused you to load into an empty level on a local game

We have a limited number of devices to test with, so if you encounter any issues with control customization please report it in our official discord, linked on our store page.

Also, if you haven't yet unlocked Slushy, today is your last day to do it!

Happy casting!

notes.title: Blagmoz Patch 1.0.1 is live
notes.notes:
This patch brings some fixes and a bit of new content!

New content:

A secret unlockable tribute character, with Landon Podbielski's blessing ;)


Bug fixes:

Fixed a bug that caused the Drill's special attack to function incorrectly
Fixed a bug that caused very long load times


Thanks for playing, everyone, and we have more Blagmoz content in the works that we'll show you soon!
